description: Bike Counts is a dataset listed in Analyzejerseycity open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Analyzejerseycity. This datasets shows the number of bikes passing through 3 intersections in Jersey City Intersection Name Data Available from Bergen & Academy 4/16/2020 Jersey Ave & Grand St 5/6/2019 Washington & Thomas Gangemi 4/29/2020 Click here to see Bike usage in Jersey City. Coverage: Jersey City, New Jersey. The portal files it under Transportation. Its keywords are bike counts, intersections, Bike. The portal shows 1,536 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-10-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-jerseycitynj-gov-portal.
